name: Travel
short: Places, routes, points and the business of getting there
audience: An independent traveller who plans their own trips, flies often enough to care about routes, fares and loyalty programmes, prefers places with a story over resorts, and wants to know about changes that affect how and where they can go.
criteria: Reward: changes to entry rules, visas, schengen and ETIAS style systems, new routes and airline or rail changes that open up places, honest destination pieces with specifics, well-researched history or oddity pieces about places, and analysis of the travel industry with consequences for travellers. Rank official travel advisories higher when the level changes. Penalise: credit card sign-up bonus promotion, sponsored hotel reviews, generic top-ten lists, luxury coverage with no practical use, and press-release rewrites.
